heading: Join the Pantry Club
intro: Small-batch coffee, preserves and a made-to-use ceramic, delivered each month. Pause or cancel from your account.

plans.name: Monthly
plans.description: Coffee, preserves and one small kitchen piece, delivered on the first Friday.
plans.note: Billed monthly. Skip or cancel any time.

plans.name: Seasonal
plans.description: Three boxes a season, timed to what our makers are harvesting and firing.

plans.name: Annual
plans.description: Twelve boxes and a thank-you from the workshop at the start of winter.
plans.note: $33 a box, billed once a year.

footnote: Prices include tax. Delivery to Canada and the EU is $6 a box.
